cases.given: The code-to-requirement story may be plausible without every criterion actually being entailed.
cases.expect: One missing error-handling criterion is found despite a plausible forward explanation.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the transformation is intentionally irreversible and no reverse contract is claimed
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: The declared transformation contract determines which information may be lost.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Do not certify when a material source constraint has no forward image or when the result implies a contradictory source condition.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: independent backward reconstruction for lossy or high-stakes transformations

cases.given: A summary reads plausibly from a report but, read alone, implies the opposite scope limitation.
cases.expect: Fail the reverse pass and identify the scope inversion.
cases.reject: Pass solely because every report section was mentioned.
